scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic identities, contact and collision comparisons, and Bezout support the uniform conclusion; direct finite-field point censuses are corroboration, not proofs for all primes. There is no independent audit or prior-art priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed integral equations and prime characteristic at least seven; no claim about other integral models, the small primes 2, 3, 5, topological fundamental groups in positive characteristic, or singularity-scheme lengths. The published paper already supplies component equations and relevant elimination polynomials; they are not presented as novel.
title: Sharp modular degenerations and an arithmetic merger of four degree-seven conic–line arrangements
